title: Meridian-holonomy q₀↦u deformation MAGNITUDE is anchor-smooth (exact boost-hyperbola amplification bound; true anchor comparison)
description: Scope-(a) NEGATIVE: the meridian-holonomy deformation magnitude channel produces an O(ppm) anchor swing (ρ≈9.6=O(10)), ~1.5e5× too smooth for the 3.47% c₃ swing; reaching the needed amplification would require q₀ within ~3e-7 of 1 (compact locus), but the substrate is ~0.11 away. Ties to Lean sensitivity_sq / barOdd_sq_le_of_amplification. No fit; nothing inverts Q_β/CODATA; no c_k wired.

assertions.name: sensitivity_sq_identity_both_anchors
assertions.source: (barEven/barOdd)² = 1 + 4/barOdd² at both q₀ anchors — the boost-hyperbola identity, probe↔Lean MeridianHolonomyAnchorCarrier.sensitivity_sq tie

assertions.name: deformation_magnitude_swing_is_ppm
assertions.source: Δ(u²)/u² across the muon↔proton q₀ anchors, coordinate FIXED (u=2 ln q). Leading-order 2·ρ_u·(Δq₀/q₀)=2.2342525e-7; barOdd-shape swing=1.1171263e-7; cross-check A1 ω home swing=4.5581062e-6

assertions.name: c3_swing_over_deformation_magnitude_swing_gt_1e4
assertions.source: (c₃ cross-anchor swing 3.47%)/(deformation-magnitude swing): decisive scope-(a) — the meridian-holonomy deformation MAGNITUDE is anchor-smooth and cannot alone realise the c₃ swing

assertions.name: substrate_far_from_compact_locus
assertions.source: Lean barOdd_sq_le_of_amplification: reaching ρ_req forces |barOdd|≤2/√(ρ_req²−1). The substrate barOdd(q₀)≈0.209 exceeds that bound by ~5 orders ⇒ the meridian deformation magnitude is ~5 orders too far from the compact locus barOdd=0 (q=±1) to supply the swing.

verdict: scope-(a) NEGATIVE — meridian-holonomy deformation MAGNITUDE anchor-smooth; swing lives in the near-singular / non-perturbative phase arg(u); bounds both this route and #4283's in-block maps.
